KAFKA-SHOCK_POTION.title: Shock Potion
KAFKA-SHOCK_POTION.description: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] (6 damage, 3 turns) to target enemy.
KAFKA-PURSUIT_POTION.title: Pursuit Potion
KAFKA-PURSUIT_POTION.description: This turn, whenever you trigger [gold]Pursuit[/gold], choose a hand card to [gold]Rewrite[/gold].
KAFKA-REWRITE_INK.title: Rewrite Ink
KAFKA-REWRITE_INK.description: Choose 1 card in hand to [gold]Rewrite[/gold]. Then randomly Rewrite 1 card from draw pile and 1 from discard pile.
